# Count: 192336 + 8*3*528 + 4 + 160 = 205172.

# Format. Lines starting with # are comments. A number in Q(sqrt2,sqrt3) is written as
# a sum of terms "m", "m*sqrt(2)", "m*sqrt(3)", "m*sqrt(6)" (m an integer; "sqrt(r)" means
# 1*sqrt(r)), e.g. 6, -2*sqrt(3), 4+sqrt(6). Every point below is a nonzero vector p, and
# the configuration is the set of unit vectors p/|p|. Points are listed as follows.
#   tail <id> <d> <T_1>,...,<T_k>     a tail: scale d (positive integer) and T in Z[sqrt2,sqrt3]^k,
#                                     k = 4; ids are 0,1,2,... in order.
#   class <id>,<id>,... <m>            followed by m head lines; a head line is 24 integers
#                                     h_1,...,h_24 (a Leech minimal vector, h.h = 32).
#                                     For each head h (in order) and each listed tail (d,T)
#                                     (in order) the point is (d*h, T) in R^24 x R^k.
#   pole <P_1>,...,<P_k>               the point (0^24, P).
#   extra <x_1>,...,<x_28>             the point x.
# Points are numbered in file order: classes, then poles, then extras.
# The first class (tail 0 = zero vector) is the Leech body; each other class is one head set
# with its tails. The heads of all classes together are the 196560 Leech minimal vectors.
